title: Approved Figure Where Veterans Pension Payments Have Been Withheld — Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery
content:
On a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**, how the approved figure for reduced withholding is taken from the proposal depends on the withholding the debtor has already borne from **Veterans Pension** payments.

## Rule

1. **Withheld in full.** When three or more monthly Veterans Pension payments were issued in the last three calendar months counted back from today, every one of them was withheld in full, and a request carrying a Financial Status Report was received on the debt in the last six calendar months, the approved figure is the full-withholding share of 75 percent of the proposal, rounded up to the cent.
2. **Withheld in part.** When pension payments in those three months were withheld in part but not in full and such a report was received, the approved figure is the proposal less the smallest reduced withholding of the debt type.
3. **Otherwise** the approved figure is the proposal as made.

**Reading the records.** From the debtor's Veterans Pension payments dated in the last three calendar months: their number, their gross amounts added together, and the amounts withheld from them added together. "Withheld in full" means the amounts withheld add up to at least the gross amounts; "in part but not in full" means some amount was withheld but less than the gross amounts. A period of three (or six) calendar months covers dates from which fewer than three (or six) whole calendar months have passed to today. A request carrying a report is any request on the debt recorded with a Financial Status Report attached.

| Debt type | Smallest reduced withholding (USD) used in clause 2 |
|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 25.00 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 25.00 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 25.00 |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 25.00 |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 25.00 |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 50.00 |

## Hypothetical cases

- Three pension payments of 1,380.00 USD each, all withheld in full, a waiver request with a report four months ago, proposal 96.60 USD: 75 percent is 72.45 USD.
- Withholding of 600.00 USD against gross payments of 4,140.00 USD, report on file, proposal 96.60 USD on a Veterans Pension Overpayment: 96.60 less 25.00, that is 71.60 USD.
- No report on file in the six months: the proposal as made.
